title: Hosted acceptance that the AI fleet surface and the alert feed hold under real load
measured_by: Human/Ops through a real login on the hosted dev environment (Antigravity committed the operator's hosted acceptance text and facts without rerunning hosted checks or accessing any VM/SSH)
operator_acceptance_text:
Pair: BFF a51fd808c (image revision label equal) and FE fe5899413, deploy run https://github.com/ajoe734/pantheon/actions/runs/42747427456 success at 04:17Z. It contains BFF-AI-FLEET-EMPTY-OK-20261109 (#7108), BFF-ALERTS-PARTIAL-20261109 (#7109) and BFF-ALERTS-WIRING-20261110 (#7110).
AC1 pass: the pair above.
AC2 pass: the non-stream ask context had persona_fleet status ok with 0 non-ok observations; the baseline on bdd2b8e54 was degraded with 40 empty-read observations. Fleet summary: 10 current personas (paper_running 4, research_only 3, draft 3), 153 retired, healthy 4, degraded 0, critical 0. This equals /bff/personas by_state, which had retired 153, research_only 3, draft 3 and paper_running 4.
AC3 pass: 30 consecutive GET /bff/alerts reads gave 28 bff_composed ok and 2 bff_composed degraded. The 2 degraded responses are the partial path, with BFF log 'bff.alerts degraded fallback: read_timeout (ManagementReadTimeout)', and still carried all 4 runtime alerts. 0 responses were an empty timeout_fallback; the baseline was 1 of 30. Latency 549-3408 ms. 3 cold loads of /management/alerts, each after a fresh login, showed 4 rows with bff_composed ok each time. With the fallback intercepted the page still shows 暫時無法取得警報資料。.
AC4: no password or token was written anywhere.
Context: the Management AI panel answer at 04:19Z was again correct (12 of 12 accepted, 11 ready and 1 ok, 4 bindings, 33 of 33, 4 critical runtime alerts). The 4 critical alerts are real: each current runtime's telemetry has a fill-rate event of 0.0 with ledger_fill_count 0.
Limitations: management_cockpit was degraded in one ask because the human inbox persona_readiness contributor exceeded its own budget under load. One non-stream ask showed loop_health unavailable, while GET /bff/v5/loop-health took 392-3251 ms over 8 reads against a 2.0 second AI prefetch bound; follow-up BFF-AI-LOOP-BUDGET-20261110 raises the bound.
